description: Create a customer-list audience from a local CSV of emails or phone numbers. Values are normalised and SHA-256 hashed on this machine; only hashes are uploaded and no raw value is ever shown or logged. Previews (counts only) unless confirm=true. Local phone numbers get default_country_code (or SNAP_DEFAULT_PHONE_CODE); without either they are counted as invalid. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

column.description: Header of the column to use; found automatically when omitted

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

default_country_code.description: Country code (digits, no +) for local numbers; defaults to SNAP_DEFAULT_PHONE_CODE. Without one, local numbers are counted as invalid.

file_path.description: Absolute path to a .csv with a header row

name: snap_upload_customer_list
